summary: Checks whether a value is **not** a presentation id.
description: `nonValidPresentationId(value)` is the same test as `!isValidPresentationId(value)`, written so that a guard clause reads as a sentence rather than as a negation.
At least 25 characters of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores — the id from a Slides URL. The format is all that is checked.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is not a presentation id; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
nonValidPresentationId("short-id"); // => true
nonValidPresentationId("has space in it and is long enough to pass"); // => true
nonValidPresentationId("1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"); // => false
```
